info.name: Curated for You Chronicle Feedback API
List pending AI feedback cards for a curation

params.name: curation_id
params.description: Curation ID to fetch feedback for

items.docs:
Return pending AI feedback cards for the given curation.

**Auth:** Regular user JWT with `org:curations:read` permission.

`action_context` is never included in the response.

Ingest a new AI feedback card.

**Auth:** Clerk M2M token only. Regular user JWTs receive 403.

Auto-populates `curation_group_number`, `company_id`, and `product_ids`
from the curation record and blocks payload.

**Response 201:** `{id, curation_id, curation_group_number, created_at}`

info.name: Execute an action on an AI feedback card

items.docs:
Execute an action on an AI feedback card.

**Auth:** Regular user JWT with `org:curations:manage` permission.

| `action_id`            | Behaviour                                          |
|------------------------|----------------------------------------------------|
| `dismiss`              | Sets `status=resolved` and `resolved_at`           |
| `apply_rules`          | Patches linked `CurationBrief` and resolves card   |
